title: Sustained high CPU from a runaway process
symptoms: CPU usage above 95% for more than 15 minutes and not resolving; the HighCPU alert stays firing. One process is pinned at 100%, request latency climbs and health checks time out.
root_cause: A process is stuck in a busy loop, a bad query or regex is looping, or traffic outgrew the host.
impact: Slow responses and timeouts on that host; it may be removed from the load balancer.
fix_steps: Identify the process: top -o %CPU or ps aux --sort=-%cpu | head.
Capture a stack dump or profile before restarting it, for later analysis.
Restart the service or drain the host from the load balancer.
Scale out if the cause is real traffic growth.
prevention: Set CPU limits per service, autoscale on CPU, and add timeouts to expensive operations.
